title.en: OpenAI Launches AI Futures Blog for Strategic Futures Team
title.zhHans: OpenAI 推出 Strategic Futures 团队的《AI Futures》博客

searchSummary.en: OpenAI launched AI Futures on August 20, 2026, framing concentration of power as a key AI risk and outlining six nonbinding principles.
searchSummary.zhHans: OpenAI 于 2026 年 8 月 20 日推出《AI Futures》，将权力集中列为关键 AI 风险，并提出六项非约束性原则。

summary.en: On August 20, 2026, OpenAI launched AI Futures, the blog of its new Strategic Futures team. Its inaugural essay frames concentration of power as a central long-term risk of transformative AI and proposes six nonbinding institutional principles, including bounded legibility and individual agency.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 8 月 20 日，OpenAI 推出新设立的 Strategic Futures 团队博客《AI Futures》。创刊文章将权力过度集中列为变革性 AI 的核心长期风险，并提出包括“有限可见性”与个体自主权在内的六项非约束性制度原则。

narrative.en: OpenAI established the Strategic Futures team and the AI Futures publication to examine constitutional and political-economy questions around transformative machine intelligence. The essay outlines six guiding principles: preserving individual autonomy, personal misuse liability, narrow collective intervention, empowering individuals against monopolies, human institutional primacy, and bounded legibility for high-stakes actions with privacy protections. The publication represents a corporate research proposal rather than binding legislation or an international agreement.
narrative.zhHans: OpenAI 设立 Strategic Futures 团队与《AI Futures》专刊，旨在探讨围绕变革性机器智能的宪政与政治经济学问题。文章提出六项指导原则：保护个体自主权、个人滥用责任制、限制集体干预范围、通过法律赋能个体抵抗寡头垄断、维持人类制度主导地位，以及在高风险行动中实施有限可见性并保护隐私。该专刊代表企业内部研究提案，不构成法定约束力立法或国际协议。

description.en: Introduces a frontier lab proposal on power concentration and institutional governance into public AI policy debate.
description.zhHans: 将前沿实验室关于权力集中与制度治理的提案引入公开 AI 政策讨论。

text.en: On August 20, 2026, OpenAI launched the Strategic Futures initiative and published an inaugural manifesto identifying concentration of power as a long-term AI risk.
text.zhHans: 2026 年 8 月 20 日，OpenAI 启动 Strategic Futures 倡议并发表创刊文章，将权力过度集中列为长期 AI 风险。

text.en: The manifesto proposed six governance principles including bounded legibility, preservation of individual agency, and protection of anonymous AI use.
text.zhHans: 文章提出了包括有限可见性、保护人类个体自主权以及保障匿名 AI 使用权在内的六项治理原则。

text.en: The publication creates a public venue for OpenAI’s institutional governance proposals without establishing binding policy.
text.zhHans: 该专刊为 OpenAI 的制度治理建议建立了公开讨论渠道，但尚未形成具有约束力的政策。

text.en: The manifesto represents corporate institutional proposals and does not constitute formal binding legislation or international treaty obligations.
text.zhHans: 该宣言属于企业提出的制度治理倡议，并不构成法定约束力立法或国际条约义务。

editorial.reviewNotes: Published after official OpenAI AI Futures blog launch and independent media analysis. Reviewed 2026-08-24 after the latest-30 evidence, calibration, and language audit.

changeLog.summary: Corrected official date to August 20, replaced 404 Semafor source with first-party post, removed enterprise workflow direction link, and calibrated significance from L2 to L1.
